title: Price-of-symmetrisation conjecture for average transmission
statement:
Let $G$ be a strongly connected graph in ${\mathcal{G}_n}$. For $2\leq n\leq 10$, define ${\mathcal{C}_n}$ to be the directed cycle on $n$ vertices. For $3\leq k\leq n-1$, let ${\mathcal{H}_n(k)}$ be the bag obtained from the tournament ${\mathcal{B}_k}$ by duplicating the arrow $(v_k,v_1)$ and replacing the duplicate by a path of length $n-k+1$. Let

$$
r=n(\sqrt{2}-1)+8-\frac{11\sqrt{2}}{2}.
$$

**Price-of-symmetrisation conjecture.** For $2\leq n\leq 10$,

$$
{\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}(G)\leq {\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}({\mathcal{C}_n}),
$$

with equality if and only if $G\simeq {\mathcal{C}_n}$. For $n\geq 11$, set

$$
k^*=\max\left({\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}({\mathcal{H}_n(\lfloor r\rfloor)}),{\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}({\mathcal{H}_n(\lceil r\rceil)})\right).
$$

Then

$$
{\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}(G)\leq {\sf P}^{-}_{\sigma}({\mathcal{H}_n(k^*)}),
$$

with equality if and only if $G\simeq {\mathcal{H}_n(k^*)}$. The conjecture identifies the extremal strongly connected graphs for the price of symmetrisation with respect to the invariant $\sigma$, with cycles for orders at most $10$ and bags for larger orders; the proposed bag parameter is determined by the two integers nearest to $r$.
source_name: Absil Romain and Hadrien Mélot, “On price of symmetrisation”, arXiv:1310.2775 (2013).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1310.2775

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2013).
